liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokestack Lightening** (2 reviews): The jam coming out of Smokestack Lightening has a Mind Left Body style section; A recognizable, though not great, Mind Left Body jam begins about 6:36 into Smokestack [11][12]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): The opening Stranger is lengthy and energetic [16]
- **CC Rider** (1 review): CC Rider is a blazing rendition with amazing solos [16]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song includes a great jam, according to the reviewer [8]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer finds Jerry's vocals on Terrapin Station captivating and endlessly replayable [18]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' is played with very high energy, followed by a bluesy Smokestack [8]
- **Stella Blue** (1 other source): Placing the track index for Stella Blue was so hard the taper nearly tore his hair out [1]
- **Day Job** (1 review): Reviewer felt the Day Job encore spoiled an otherwise good show [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-10.senn.pa-deli.mike.83219.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer ranks this PA Deli Mike source the second best sounding version of the show; Uploader describes the sound quality of this recording in a small venue as superb [1][13]
- **gd1985-03-10.176254.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 138 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd85-03-10.senn421.barbella.10255.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 134 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds quite bassy, though still decent to listen to; The reviewer finds this audience recording a bit boomy [8][10]
- **gd1985-03-10.senn421.mccue.84291.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 136 min [6]. Said about its sound: The recording has bass distortion at points [6]
- **gd1985-03-10.nak300.holtz.JAZ.96594.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 135 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the Nak300 Holtz source excellent sounding; Reviewer ranks this source the second best sounding version of the show [12][14]

## Around the show

- The floor of Berkeley Community Theater has roughly 41 rows [6]
- Reviewer recalls the 11/1/85 Richmond show also ending with Day Job after a superb second set [15]
- Described as the second and best show of a four-night Berkeley run, often overlooked [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-10.senn.pa-deli.mike.83219.flac16**: taped by PA Deli Mike; transferred by Mr Chips; source: 2x Sennheiser 441's > Sony TCD5-M > Maxell MX [1]
- **gd1985-03-10.176254.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 421 mics (L/R) + (1) Sennheiser 441 mic (C) blend > Nakamichi 550 > Sony D5 (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: A Sennheiser 421 source from McCue and Ford patches a short gap in Big Railroad Blues and one in Drums into Space [3]
- **gd85-03-10.senn421.barbella.10255.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording FOB Senn421's [4]. Also: Sennheiser 421 front-of-board audience tape: master cassette to DAT to CD, via Raul Duke, seeded by Steve Barbella [4]
- **gd1985-03-10.senn421.mccue.84291.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue; transferred by Alex Ford; source: Sennheiser 421s > Sony D5 > 2 TDK MA90s [6]. Also: Mark McCue provided master audience cassettes; Alex Ford did transfer, edits, conversion and seeding [6]
- **gd1985-03-10.nak300.holtz.JAZ.96594.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by JAZ; source: Nakamichi cm 300's CP-4 guns -> D-5 [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brian Baumwoll Grateful Dead: [1985-03-12 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-03-12-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1985-03-10 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1985-03-10-backstage-pass/) [22]
